description: Signal8 cash position model for a company, derived from the dilution snapshot pipeline: anchor cash and anchor date, monthly burn, post-anchor capital raises (with SEC filing citations), known outflows, estimated current cash and runway months. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. Coverage is partial: `available: false` with reason `snapshot_not_generated` means this company has not been analysed yet, which is different from it having no cash data and different from an outage (an outage is a 5xx). An unavailable response says nothing about whether the company has cash or runway. The `scenarios` envelope is kept for compatibility but only `scenarios.closed` is populated: `pending` and `announced` are null with reason `scenario_not_modelled`, because the extraction records only realized cash-raising events and does not model speculative raises; shelf or ATM capacity is not a modelled raise. Currency: amounts are in the filer's reporting currency, which is not always USD (Canadian, European, Japanese and Chinese filers report in their own currency). Top-level `currency` is ISO 4217 (null = not determined), and `currencySource: "presumed_usd"` means no foreign-currency marker was found, not a measurement. Every money object is {usd, native: {amount, currency}}: `usd` (and scenarios.closed.estimatedCashUsd / adjustedEstimatedCashUsd / netCapitalRaisesUsd) is null when the block is not in USD, and nothing is converted, so `native.amount` is in `native.currency`, not dollars. monthsOfCashLeft is currency-neutral and stays populated. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_cash_position
title: Get AI Cash Position
